description: This file contains utility functions to determine the verification status of a Matrix device based on its status object. It exports three functions to check if a device is locally verified, owner verified, or verified in the current client context.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified( isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device's localVerified property is true.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified( isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Checks if the device is verified by cross-signing or signed by owner.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient( isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient
methods.description: Determines if the device is verified either via the isVerified method, locally verified, or owner verified.
